subtitle: Run, plant, run farther
description:
Sow Far is an endless running game with a garden. Your runner, a little sower in a big pink hat, runs along a country lane on her own. Touch to jump and hold to jump higher, clearing brambles, pits, tall stumps and low-flying crows. Collect seeds as you go. You have three hearts, and the run ends when they are gone.

The twist: you don't spend your seeds in a shop. You plant them on the lane itself. After each run the view pulls back over the course, and you choose which bare plots to sow. A vine bridge across the chasm you keep falling into. A spring mushroom in front of the stump that always trips you. A heartfruit tree to give back a heart. Berry bushes that burst with seeds every time you pass.

The lane is the same every run, so you learn it, and your garden grows along it. Each run you pass your own bushes, bounce off your own mushrooms and cross your own bridges, and you get a little farther. Berry bushes keep ripening while you are away, so there is always something waiting when you come back.

The lane gets faster and busier the farther you go. Beat your best distance.

Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Run the lane, collect seeds, then plant bridges, bushes and mushrooms right on the course. Your garden grows, and every run goes a little farther.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Touch to jump and hold to jump higher; avoid brambles, pits, stumps and crows. After a run, tap a plot's stake in the soil and tap its card to plant with collected seeds, then tap anywhere else to run again. The run ends when all 3 hearts are lost.
